summary: Make a fictional community legible through shared paths, sheltered gathering spaces and a recurring woodland motif.
objective: Paths visibly reach the important buildings and magical accents do not conceal entrances or characters.
intent_signals: Set the scene in a fantasy woodland community
Use fantasy woodland as the narrative setting
example_prompts: Create an enchanted woodland settlement whose residents visibly travel between distinct workplaces.

principles: Make a fictional community legible through shared paths, sheltered gathering spaces and a recurring woodland motif.
Theme supplies setting and motifs; choose geometry style, rendering approach and factual model independently.
implementation: Shape houses around invented root or mushroom forms, but give entrances, bridges and supports readable connections.
Use a deliberate mix of timber-like, leaf-like and luminous accents with a warm focal light; keep the forest background grouped.
Offer an inviting path-level view and an overview; give residents distinct routes and rest points rather than universal bobbing.
observable_checks: Paths visibly reach the important buildings and magical accents do not conceal entrances or characters.
Inspect one focal object close up and the complete route or spatial relationship from an overview.

known_limits: Authored fictional setting guidance; no rendered artifact or runtime improvement has been observed for this record.
This proposal does not establish historical, cultural, scientific or engineering facts.
creative_affordances: Combine with clay, painterly or stylized realism; the setting is invented and any real ecological claim needs separate grounding.
Replace motifs or combine settings to suit the user brief; maintain a readable organizing idea rather than treating these suggestions as a fixed asset list.
